  <section v="6">

    <t s="17">And like Rabbi Zeira, when he ascended to the Land of Israel, he sat42</t>
    <t s="18">one hundred fasts</t>

    <t s="20">to forget the Babylonian Talmud so that he could learn the Jerusalem Talmud44],</t>
    <t s="21">so too is it regarding the commandments and good deeds of a person,</t>
    <t s="22">that because they are clothed in physical matters,</t>

  <section v="7">

    <t s="25">and "the heavens"</t>
    <t s="26">(with the addition of the letter hei)</t>
    <t s="27">is the very highest level within the heavens</t>
    <t s="28">(the heaven of heavens),</t>
    <t s="29">and "toward the heavens"</t>
    <t s="30">(with the addition of the letter hei also at the beginning)</t>

  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the connection between the garments of the commandments and the days, because the ascent of the commandments is through prayer, which is the "service of the day," refining the sparks of each specific day.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is one of the explanations of the connection between the garments of the commandments and the matter of days</t>
    <t s="2">(in their simple sense),</t>
    <t s="3">for the ascent of the commandments is through prayer,</t>
    <t s="4">and prayer is "the matter of the service of the day"</t>

    <t s="7">"the continual burnt-offering that is performed every day,</t>
    <t s="8">two each day"55],</t>
    <t s="9">that the prayer of each day refines and elevates the sparks that were renewed on that day56,</t>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the commandments in this physical world need the assistance of angels not only because the world is mostly evil, but also because of its physicality, which is incomparable to the spiritual worlds, requiring a prior stripping away of physicality.

translations.translation: Now, that the commandments and good deeds in this physical world need and require the assistance of the angels is not only because this physical world is for the most part evil,
but
(also39)
because of the physicality of this world40.
For being physical, it is incomparable to the upper worlds
(the spiritual ones).
And this is analogous to what is known regarding the soul of man,
that even a completely righteous person, when ascending to the Garden of Eden, needs immersion in the River of Fire in order to forget the sight of this world,
for because of the incomparability of this physical world to the Garden of Eden, even a small part of the matters of this world prevents one from ascending to the Garden of Eden41
[and this is similar to the ascents among the levels of the Garden of Eden, from the lower Garden of Eden to the upper Garden of Eden, etc.,
that since the ascents are incomparable,
there must first be a nullification of the comprehension of the lower Garden of Eden41.
And this is known from the parable regarding the attainment of the intellect,
that in order to come to a higher attainment that is incomparable to the previous attainment
(even though the higher attainment is also in this physical world)
there must first be a nullification of the previous attainment.
And like Rabbi Zeira, when he ascended to the Land of Israel, he sat42
one hundred fasts
(or forty fasts43)
to forget the Babylonian Talmud so that he could learn the Jerusalem Talmud44],
so too is it regarding the commandments and good deeds of a person,
that because they are clothed in physical matters,
they must first be refined and stripped of their physicality by means of the angels.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that although the refinement of the commandments is done by angels, the beginning of this process is through man's service, specifically prayer, which acts as a ladder connecting the lowest earth to the highest heaven, elevating the commandments.

translations.translation: And it can be said, as a possibility, that even though the refinement of the commandments and their ascent upward is done by the angels,
nevertheless,
since the ultimate perfection of every matter is when it is done through the service of man
(and therefore a person prefers his own kab [measure] specifically45),
therefore, also the matter of the refinement of the commandments,
its beginning is through the service of man.
And this is what is stated in Torah Or46
that the laundering and refinement of the commandments is through the service of prayer,
and the intention in this is
(not only that through prayer one cleanses the commandments from all waste,
so that they will not be in a manner of not for its own sake and the like,
but rather),
that through prayer there is also accomplished
(the beginning47
of)
their refinement,
that they are refined from their physicality and ascend upward.
For prayer is a ladder planted on the earth whose head reaches the heavens48,
meaning that prayer connects the two extremes of earth and heaven
(below and above49),
and particularly according to what is known50
that "the earth"
(with the addition of the letter hei)
is the very lowest level within this physical earth itself,
and "the heavens"
(with the addition of the letter hei)
is the very highest level within the heavens
(the heaven of heavens),
and "toward the heavens"
(with the addition of the letter hei also at the beginning)
is above even "the heavens."
And this is "a ladder planted on the earth whose head reaches the heavens,"
that through prayer "it is possible for an ascent even
(of the person)
who is on the earth, in the very lowest levels of this physical earth, to the heavens, to the most exalted and wondrous levels"51.
Now, just as prayer affects the person,
that even when he is on the earth he can elevate himself to the heavens
(except that there must also be the assistance of the angels of "embracing," etc.),
so too does it affect all of a person's matters52
and particularly his commandments and good deeds53
that through the four rungs of prayer
(which correspond to the four worlds)
they ascend from world to world,
until they ascend to the aspect of "the heavens" that is above the worlds,
and until they ascend to His very Essence and Self, may He be blessed.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the connection between the garments of the commandments and the days, because the ascent of the commandments is through prayer, which is the "service of the day," refining the sparks of each specific day.

translations.translation: And this is one of the explanations of the connection between the garments of the commandments and the matter of days
(in their simple sense),
for the ascent of the commandments is through prayer,
and prayer is "the matter of the service of the day"
[as is also understood from the words of our Rabbis, may their memory be blessed54
that prayers were instituted corresponding to the daily offerings,
"the continual burnt-offering that is performed every day,
two each day"55],
that the prayer of each day refines and elevates the sparks that were renewed on that day56,
therefore the commandments
[whose ascent is through prayer]
need the "service of the day"57.
